brief: c288: 4 of 34 fair days filled 0 slots. fairGathering() refuses on `raining` and the gathering is the only window the fair has, so a shower at the raise costs the whole day even when it clears by noon. #194 built the fair as a shape on the sun (fairF: up 1.6 h, hold, down 1.5 h) with one crowd window; #198 found the same shape in the garden — a weather gate carried from a time when nothing had a roof. Measure first over 6 seeds x a year: of the fair days that fill 0 slots, how many were raining at the raise and dry for the rest of the window. Then make the fair survive a shower — the concert's shape can be re-offered when the sky clears, or admission can be asked at the CHOICE per arrival instead of once at the raise.
successLooksLike: Fair days filling 0 slots fall to the days that are actually wet across the whole window. A dry afternoon after a wet morning fills the ellipse. The fair-day presence ratios #194 measured (plaza presence 15.51 v 9.81, standers 3.00 v 1.35, pinned ref 8682828) do not fall on the days that already worked.
avoid: Do not raise FAIR_SLOTS or the share — the supply is 10 claimed slots and #194 measured them under-used. And do not make the fair rain-proof: a crowd standing in the rain is a worse picture than a fair that waits. END a one-shot choice AT THE CLAIM — a re-offer guarded only by the state it consumes is re-entrant.
